## Differential peaks (DP)


### DP Summary

```{r }
if (exists('dp_sum')){
dp_sum %>% 
  DT::datatable(
  class = 'cell-border stripe', 
  rownames = T,  
  filter = 'top', 
  editable = F, 
  extensions = 'Buttons', 
  options = list(
    pageLength = 6, 
    dom = 'Bfrtip',
    buttons = c('csv')
  ))
}
```

$$\\[0.2in]$$

### DP plots {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r display_plots, results='asis', fig.cap=c('Fig. Differential expression analysis. (A) PCA plot. (B) MA/MD plot. (C) Volcano plot'), fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
if (exists('dp.list')){
for (tgt in targets){
  cat ('####', tgt, '{.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n') # target level
  
  cnp <- grep(tgt, names(dp.list), value = T)
  
  for (i in cnp){
    cat ('#####', i, '{.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n') # conp level
    dp <- dp.list[[i]]
    dp[sapply(dp, is.null)] <- NULL
    for (j in 1:length(dp)){
      plist <- dp[[j]]$plots
      p <- wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 1) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')
      
      make_tabs(
        paste("######", names(dp)[j]),
        list(p)
      )
    }
  }
}

}
```
